title: 第125章 铁腕惩奸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

说完这话,她抬了抬手，都不必府内的人开门，那些兵卒早就一脚将大门踹开。

当兵卒举着火把一路横冲进来的时候,找寻府内府外，除了一些睡得迷糊的下人丫鬟，便再无旁人了。

方锦书冷面瞪着一个吓得瑟瑟发抖的丫鬟，咬牙问道：“苏落云那贱人在何处？”

那丫鬟吓得瑟瑟发抖，急声道：“太子妃迁回这里后，便一直不出房门，我们都是将饭菜端送到门口，由太子妃的大丫鬟端进去的。她……她应该就在屋子里啊！”

听了那丫鬟说,方锦书从身边的侍卫腰间抽出了利刃，走入苏落云的房间。

那屋内一片漆黑,不过掩在帷幔的床里似乎发出恐惧呜咽的声音。

也是,一个看不见的瞎子,听见深夜踹门的声音，的确是该害怕了。

方锦书冷笑提刀过去,一把掀开了幔帐，用刀挑开了被子后，举刀就往那人的脸上砍去，

她对苏落云的恨意实在积压太久了！

有无数个深夜，她都深深后悔，不该在第一次见苏落云时,被她言语忽悠，轻巧放过了这个女人。

若是那时，她就用匕首划花了贱人的脸，是不是就省下了以后许多麻烦？

现在,她要先给苏落云的俏脸划下几刀，解一解心头之恨。

想到这，她朝枕头的方向狠狠砍去。

不过也奇怪，方锦书都感觉到血迹迸溅到自己脸上了，那床榻上的人居然没有大喊。

就在这时，有人点了蜡烛，屋内的光景呈现在她眼前。

而床榻上的人也因为疼痛难忍，挣扎滚落到了床下。

方锦书定睛一看，满脸血污女子也不像是苏落云啊！而且她的嘴里还堵着布，身上也绑缚着绳子。

待擦了她脸上的血污，取了布条之后，那女子才痛喊出声：“瑞王妃饶命！饶命啊！”

方锦书凝神看了一会，这才猛然想起这眼熟的女子为谁，她不是苏落云的贴身侍女怀夏吗？

“你怎么在这？”

怀夏疼得都要岔气了，只痛哭道：“奴婢也不知，我原本是在宫里好好睡觉的，也不知怎么的就突然来了这里……”

方锦书环视了一圈，却发现屋内摆设整齐，那桌面似乎都落了一层灰，很明显已经很久没人在这居住了……

她再回头看哭哭啼啼的怀夏，心里突然一紧，隐隐有些不好的感觉。

就在这时，巷子外的街市突然传来纷乱的声音，似乎有许多人朝着青鱼巷涌来。

就在方锦书带着人急急往外走去的时候，却发现整个巷子已经被包围得水泄不通。

当那些身穿铁面军铠甲的勇士一股脑涌入巷子，将她和手下死死堵住的时候，方锦书力持镇定，大声道：‘我乃瑞王遗孀，故去先皇的儿媳妇，尔等何人！为何拦住我的去路？”

为首的男子面色黝黑，手腕上环着一圈表示战功赫赫的纹身牛角。

他压根没有被方锦书的话呼喝住，只瞪眼说道：“我奉太子之名，来此擒拿意图谋反作乱的罪人方锦书，既然你是瑞王遗孀，那就对了！”

说话间，他举刀便要过来拿人。

不过方锦书的护卫也不是吃素的，连忙护着瑞王妃急急后撤。可就在这时，挨着世子府的隔壁院子——苏落云以前的那屋宅里突然翻墙而过许多兵将，将方锦书这一行人前后夹击，围得退无可退。

在一阵刀枪剑戟的混战里，方锦书也惨遭波及，只听她凄厉的一声惨叫，右侧的眼睛被深深划出伤痕。

当她披头散发，被狼狈按在地上时，还在竭力高呼：“何人敢碰我！我乃九皇子遗孀！皇帝在宫中已经驾崩！我儿将登皇位，我堂堂一国皇太后，敢碰我者，杀你九族！”

她被捆绑上，一路被扯拽出巷子时，却发现整条通往皇宫的大街站满了全副武装的兵卒，看着他们的兵服颜色，并非自己父亲和几个世家调来的兵将，而是黑衣黑甲的铁面军。

这铁面军乃韩临风的直系，原本该是折返北地，准备继续北征的，不知为何，毫无预兆出现在京城满街都是！

方锦书看着街上密密麻麻的铁面军，脸上的伤口火辣辣的疼，心里更是急得火烧火燎，一路下沉。

既然韩临风的铁面军突然出现，是不是宫里的宫变，进行得不甚顺利？

该死！那个游山樾不是一早就允诺，他已经说服了远在云州的渔阳公主，倒戈向世子，并且说服赵栋拥立九皇子遗孤吗？

宫里到底发生了什么，她的父亲又在何处？

就在这时，隔壁甜水巷里有一辆马车缓缓行驶出来。

当行驶到了方锦书的眼前时，马车的车帘微微撩起，一张明丽的脸儿出现了车帘之后。

方锦书被按在地上，半抬起头一看，那马车里坐着的正是她方才遍寻不到的苏落云！

原来她一直在这，只是并非人人以为的原世子府，而是一巷之隔的甜水巷子里。

而此时，苏落云冷着眉眼上下打量着她，压根也不像犯了眼疾的样子！难道这几日的功夫，她的眼疾又好了？

“苏落云！这是你给我设下的圈套？你知道我是谁？我是未来的皇太后！你个下堂妇居然敢抓我？好大的胆子！”

听了方锦书的叫嚣，苏落云只是冷冷道：“所谓圈套，也要有人肯钻才行。你到今日，都是自己作出来的，我可没有这么大的本事，陷你于不义之地。”

方锦书却不甘心地笑道：“你以为抓了我，你就稳操胜券了？你知不知道，你的大靠山已经倒了！那韩临风葬身在了彦县，这都是你害的！如果当初他娶的是我，而不是你，那么他也不会这么早，就惨死在滔天洪水里！”

落云已经是懒得跟疯婆子再讲下去了。一旁的香草听不下去了，故意高声道：“太子妃，太子还在宫里等着您呢，就别耽误功夫，跟个不要脸的疯子多言语了！”

方锦书听到了香草的话，呆愣住了，呆傻道：“怎么可能，他怎么可能再次躲避过彦县的洪水？”

Page (1/3)

After saying this, she raised her hand, and the soldiers kicked the door open without anyone in the house opening the door.

When the soldiers rushed in with torches, they found no one else inside or outside the mansion except some servants and maids who were sleeping in a daze.

Fang Jinshu glared coldly at a maid who was shivering with fear, gritted his teeth and asked, "Where is that bitch Su Luoyun?"

The maid was so frightened that she trembled and said anxiously: "After the Crown Princess moved back here, she never left the room. We always brought the food to the door, and the Crown Princess's eldest maid carried it in. She...she should be in the house!"

After hearing what the maid said, Fang Jinshu took out the sharp blade from the waist of the guard beside him and walked into Su Luoyun's room.

The room was dark, but there seemed to be a sound of fearful whimpering coming from the bed hidden by the curtains.

Also, an invisible blind man should indeed be afraid when he hears the sound of the door being kicked in late at night.

Fang Jinshu sneered, raised the knife, opened the curtain, lifted the quilt with the knife, then raised the knife and chopped off the man's face.

Her hatred for Su Luoyun has been pent-up for too long!

There were countless late nights when she deeply regretted that she should not have been deceived by her words when she first met Su Luoyun and let this woman go.

If she had slashed the bitch's face with a dagger at that time, would it have saved her a lot of trouble in the future?

Now, she wanted to cut Su Luoyun's pretty face a few times to relieve the hatred in her heart.

Thinking of this, she slashed hard in the direction of the pillow.

But it was strange that Fang Jinshu felt blood spattering on his face, but the person on the bed didn't yell.

Just then, someone lit a candle, and the scene in the house appeared before her eyes.

The person on the bed struggled and rolled down the bed because of the unbearable pain.

Fang Jinshu took a closer look and saw that the woman with a bloody face didn't look like Su Luoyun!Moreover, her mouth was gagged with cloth and her body was tied with rope.

After wiping the blood on her face and taking away the cloth, the woman cried out in pain: "Princess Rui, please spare your life! Please spare your life!"

Fang Jinshu watched for a while, and then suddenly remembered who this familiar woman was. Wasn't she Su Luoyun's personal maid Huai Xia?

"Why are you here?"

Huai Xia was so painful that she almost lost her breath, and she just cried bitterly: "I don't know, I was sleeping well in the palace, but I suddenly came here for some reason..."

Fang Jinshu looked around and found that the furnishings in the house were neatly arranged, and the tabletop seemed to be covered with a layer of dust. It was obvious that no one had lived here for a long time...

She looked back at Huai Xia, who was crying. Her heart suddenly tightened, and she felt vaguely bad.

At this moment, there was a sudden commotion from the market outside the alley, and it seemed that many people were rushing towards Qingyu Alley.

Just as Fang Jinshu and his men hurriedly walked out, they found that the entire alley had been surrounded.

When those warriors wearing iron armor poured into the alley and blocked her and her men, Fang Jinshu kept calm and said loudly: 'I am the widow of King Rui, the daughter-in-law of the late emperor, who are you!Why are you blocking my way?"

The man in the lead had a dark complexion and a circle of tattooed horns around his wrist that represented great military exploits.

He was not stopped by Fang Jinshu's words at all, he only glared and said: "In the name of the prince, I am here to capture Fang Jinshu, the sinner who intends to commit rebellion. Since you are the widow of King Rui, that's right!"

As he spoke, he raised his knife and wanted to come over to get someone.

However, Fang Jinshu's bodyguard was not a vegetarian and quickly protected Princess Rui and retreated hastily.But at this moment, in the yard next to the Prince's Mansion - Su Luoyun's former house, many soldiers and generals suddenly climbed over the wall and attacked Fang Jinshu and his party from front to back, leaving them unable to retreat.

In a melee with swords, guns, and halberds, Fang Jinshu was also severely affected. She only heard a shrill scream, and her right eye was deeply scratched.

When she was pushed to the ground with disheveled hair, she was still shouting with all her strength: "Who dares to touch me!I am the widow of the Ninth Prince!The emperor has died in the palace!My son will ascend the throne, and I am the empress dowager of a country. Anyone who dares to touch me will kill all nine of your clans!"

When she was tied up and dragged out of the alley, she found that the entire street leading to the palace was filled with fully armed soldiers. Looking at the color of their uniforms, they were not soldiers sent by her father and several aristocratic families, but iron-faced soldiers in black clothes and armor.

This iron-faced army is directly related to Han Linfeng. It was supposed to return to the north and prepare to continue the northern expedition. For some reason, it appeared on the streets of the capital without any warning!

Fang Jinshu looked at the densely packed iron-masked soldiers on the street. The wounds on his face were burning with pain, and his heart was burning with anxiety, sinking all the way.

Since Han Linfeng's iron-faced army suddenly appeared, is it because the palace changes are not going smoothly?

Damn it!Didn't You Shanyue promise early on that he had already convinced Princess Yuyang who was far away in Yunzhou to turn against the crown prince, and persuaded Zhao Dong to support the Ninth Prince's orphan?

What happened in the palace and where is her father?

At this moment, a carriage slowly drove out from Sweetwater Lane next door.

When they arrived in front of Fang Jinshu, the curtain of the carriage was slightly lifted, and a bright face appeared behind the curtain.

Fang Jinshu was pinned to the ground, and when he raised his head, he saw that the person sitting in the carriage was Su Luoyun, whom she had not been able to find just now!

It turned out that she had always been here, but it was not the original Prince's Mansion that everyone thought, but in the Tianshui Alley across the street.

At this time, Su Luoyun looked at her up and down with cold eyebrows, and it didn't look like she had an eye disease at all!Could it be that in the past few days, her eye disease has improved again?

"Su Luoyun!Is this a trap you set for me?Do you know who I am?I am the future empress dowager!How dare you, my concubine, arrest me?What a courage!"

After hearing Fang Jinshu's shouting, Su Luoyun just said coldly: "The so-called trap requires someone who is willing to take advantage of it.You have done it yourself until now, and I am not so capable as to trap you in an unjust place."

Fang Jinshu smiled reluctantly and said, "Do you think that if you catch me, you will be sure of victory?Do you know that your biggest supporter has fallen?That Han Linfeng was buried in Yan County, it was all your fault!If he had married me instead of you, then he would not have died miserably in the flood so early!"

Luoyun was too lazy to continue talking to the crazy woman.Vanilla on the side couldn't listen anymore and deliberately said loudly: "Princess, the prince is still waiting for you in the palace, so don't waste your time and talk to a shameless lunatic!"

Fang Jinshu was stunned when he heard what Vanilla said, and said stupidly: "How is it possible, how could he avoid the flood in Yan County again?"
